people._note: who runs this workspace (asked at first-run setup)

identity._note: paths to the brand's own identity files, absolute or relative to this copy

colors._note: theme = the kit theme picked at setup (studio, harbor, ochre or ink). Each reel's reel.json uses {"theme": {"preset": <theme>, "accent": <accent>}}; background and ink only if the brand has its own.

posting._note: How this brand's reels get posted: "by hand" (default), "instagram-scheduler", "tool: <name>" or "own publisher". Set with /reel-posting. Timezone for scheduling, e.g. America/Toronto. days and time: the brand's usual posting days (e.g. ["tue", "thu"]) and time ("18:00"), set with /content-calendar days; the calendar marks empty ones as open slots.

dashboard._note: The content dashboard (/content-calendar, docs/dashboard.md). OFF until the brand owner turns each part on: instagram, facebook, threads = read this brand's own numbers on each through Meta's APIs (docs/connect.md); telegram = send the summary to the owner's phone; refresh = off, daily or weekly, set by /content-calendar auto (time on this computer's clock). host = where the page is viewed: local (default), wifi, netlify (suggested), cloudflare or folder (any other host), set by /content-calendar host; site = the Netlify site id or Cloudflare Pages project; url = its address, for the Telegram link. publish_every = with a host set, the online copy follows your changes at most every this many minutes (0 = only on the scheduled refresh). Tokens live in ~/.config/bagelunit-reels/, written by the owner.

batch._note: Weekly batch: the most reels Claude plans in one sitting for this brand. Each reel is still approved on its own. Goals may repeat; angles may not.

autopilot._note: OFF by default. The brand owner turns a permission on, see template CLAUDE.md section 3b

updates._note: ON by default. true = at the start of a session, Claude checks once whether a newer kit version is out and tells you. It reads one public file from GitHub and never updates anything by itself.
